scope: Historical motivation, not restoration of quantitative attribution evidence
regime: Uniform-masking pretrained encoders followed by supervised fine-tuning for glaucoma; not frozen primary MeanPool evaluation
method: Feature interventions: zero slice vectors; omit one encoded patch from the mean using (total-patch)/(P-1); compare classifier logits
selection: Correctly classified cases and slices chosen using attribution magnitude; not a representative cohort estimate
allowed_use: Explain how selected exploratory maps motivated anatomical target selection
not_claimed: findings on the untouched pretrained encoder
